title: Science Corporation implants its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient
hook_text: An implant just restored a patient's vision.
script:
Science Corporation just implanted its PRIMA vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient.
Max Hodak, CEO of Science Corporation and former president of Neuralink, shared the update onstage at TechCrunch Disrupt.
Stargardt disease is an inherited form of macular degeneration that leads to blindness.
The subretinal wireless photovoltaic chip receives projection from augmented reality style glasses worn by the patient.
This first medical trial milestone is part of Science Corporation's path toward a novel brain-computer interface.
Would you trust a brain-computer chip in your eye?
